title: mdm.lock
description: The mdm v2 unified project lock. Records every project-scoped install (skills, agent definitions, knowledge bundles, plugins), the configured harnesses, and the scope's install mode. Written by the mdm CLI; unknown keys are preserved across rewrites.

version.description: Lock format version. Version 2 adds installMode; version 1 files are read and upgraded in place. A file written by a newer mdm than the one reading it aborts the command.

installMode.description: How this scope's skills and agent definitions are placed into each harness's directory. Absent means symlink (the default). Switch with --copy / --symlink on mdm skills add, mdm skills install, or mdm agents add.

configuredHarnesses.description: Harness names (e.g. claude-code, cursor) that mdm installs into by default. Managed by mdm harnesses add / remove and updated by mdm rules link.

configuredAgents.description: Pre-release spelling of configuredHarnesses. mdm reads it as a fallback and rewrites it under the new key.

skills.description: Installed skills, keyed by skill name. Restore with mdm skills install.

agents.description: Installed agent definitions (subagent persona files), keyed by the sanitized definition name. Restore with mdm agents install.

knowledge.description: Installed OKF knowledge bundles, keyed by bundle name. Restore with mdm knowledge install.

plugins.description: Installed Agent Plugins, keyed by plugin name. Restore with mdm plugins install.

source.description: Where the entry was installed from: GitHub shorthand (owner/repo), a git URL, or a local path.

ref.description: Git ref (tag, branch, or commit) the entry is pinned to.

skillPath.description: Path of the skill's SKILL.md inside the source tree, when the skill is not at the root.

agentPath.description: Path of the definition file inside the source tree. Required: a definition has no well-known file name, so the path is what lets mdm refresh it.

format.description: Shape of the canonical file under .agents/agents. Absent means markdown; "toml" means a Codex TOML source.

subpath.description: Directory inside the source that holds the bundle.

installDir.description: Slash-separated directory relative to the project root the bundle is installed into.

specVersion.description: Open Knowledge Format (OKF) spec version the bundle declares.

subpath.description: Directory inside the source that holds the plugin.

installDir.description: Slash-separated directory relative to the project root the plugin is installed into (under .agents/plugins).

dataDir.description: Persistent PLUGIN_DATA directory, preserved across updates and deleted only by mdm plugins remove --purge-data.

specVersion.description: Agent Plugins spec version the manifest declares.

version.description: The plugin manifest's own version field.

skills.description: Sanitized names of the skills the plugin installed into harness skill directories.

skillAgents.description: Harnesses the plugin's skills were installed for.

mcp.description: Harness name to the namespaced MCP server ids written into that harness's MCP config.
